title: Community Service Writing Task
originality_declaration: Created from scratch for this repository; not derived from a real exam or online writing prompt.

body.scenario: A neighborhood service station plans to combine appointment guidance, elder-friendly assistance, and feedback collection into one routine service process.
body.prompt: Write an analysis and proposal for improving the service process. Focus on resident needs, operational feasibility, and feedback loops.
suggested_structure: Describe how to evaluate the result.
